mandatoryCriteria: Owner authority: Workspace owner can resend or revoke any invitation across workspace projects

Project Manager authority limit: Project Manager can resend or revoke member and viewer invitations only in their granted project; attempting to resend or revoke a manager invitation returns 403 FORBIDDEN

Token rotation on resend: Resending rotates the cryptographic token with fresh 256-bit entropy, updates SHA-256 hash in project_invitations, refreshes expires_at (+7 days), transitions status to 'pending', and emits a fresh outbox event
Prior token invalidation: Prior token is immediately invalidated upon resend; subsequent attempts to accept the old token fail
Revocation status transition: Revoking sets status to 'revoked' under row-level lock; revoked tokens cannot be accepted
Sibling project privacy: Outsiders and non-members receive 404 NOT_FOUND on resend and revoke endpoints
Concurrency and race protection: Concurrent accept vs revoke/resend operations serialize cleanly via PostgreSQL row-level locks with at most one winner
Idempotency support: Resend and revoke mutations require and enforce Idempotency-Key with transactional replay receipts
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/invitations/:invitationId/resend and POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/invitations/:invitationId/revoke endpoints, token rotation, outbox dispatch events, status transitions, row-level locking, and idempotency on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Pending invitation list retrieval is covered by INV-05.
